queries.name: headline
queries.query: EVALUATE ROW("Conversion Rate", [Conversion Rate], "Paid Revenue", [Paid Revenue])

queries.name: channels
queries.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Sales Channel'[sales_channel], "Conversion Rate", [Conversion Rate], "Paid Revenue", [Paid Revenue])

live_measures.Name: Eligible Sessions
live_measures.Expression:
COALESCE(
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Sessions[session_id]),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[is_eligible] = TRUE()),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1))
    ),
    0
)

live_measures.Name: Converted Sessions
live_measures.Expression:
COALESCE(
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Orders[session_id]),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[is_eligible] = TRUE()),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "paid"),
        KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1))
    ),
    0
)

live_measures.Name: Paid Revenue
live_measures.Expression:
CALCULATE(
    SUM(Orders[amount_eur]),
    KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[is_eligible] = TRUE()),
    KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1)),
        KEEPFILTERS(Sessions[session_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1)),
    KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "paid"),
    KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1))
)
